{{Top|leg}}
'''Deep Space Target Practice Units''', also known as '''Target Drones''' for short, were small drones used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Used in an operation planned by [[Berd Lin]] to liberate the captive students of [[Harix]], the units were made to project a sensor reading far larger than their physical mass, creating the illusion of a substantial fleet.
